newsitem.title: USA: Helmerich & Payne to increase U.S. rigs.
newsitem.headline: Helmerich & Payne to increase U.S. rigs.

text.p: Helmerich & Payne International Drilling Co, a wholly owned subsidiary of Helmerich & Payne Inc, said Thursday it plans to increase its U.S. rig fleet.

With nearly 100 percent activity in its 28 land rig operation for the past year, H&P said it will increase the fleet to 36 by building two rigs at its own facilities and ordering six new rigs from IRI International Corp.

The company said its 29th rig in the fleet began operations on July 1 in South Texas for Exxon Corp. It recently began construction of another rig which should be available for service around October. The other rigs are expected to be delivered at various times during the first six months of 1998.

H&P said it also bought three land rigs in Bolivia in late June, and will now own and operate four medium to deep capacity rigs in the country. The company said there is substantial improvement in the outlook for Bolivian rig activity.
